title: Wine Cellar Temperature and Humidity Stability
dataSources: Fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), kegerator pours (`kegerator:pour`), wine-cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`).
app: Fermentation sensors (Tilt/iSpindel hydrometer, temperature), kegerator flow meters and scales, and wine-cellar climate sensors via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=winecellar:reading
| timechart span=1h avg(temp_c) as temp, avg(humidity_pct) as humidity
| eval temp_ok=if(temp>=11 AND temp<=15,1,0)
description: Trends your wine storage temperature and humidity to prove your bottles are ageing in stable, cellar-like conditions.
value: Wine is ruined slowly by temperature swings; a steady-conditions record protects a collection you cannot taste-test until it is too late.
implementation: Ingest cellar climate sensors; review temperature and humidity stability over time.
visualization: Dual-axis line chart of cellar temperature and humidity.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps track of how steady the temperature and humidity are where you store your wine, protecting the bottles as they age.
